judge.rationale: The candidate implements the core `ToolRegistry` validation logic in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` using `ajv` and a `WeakMap` cache similarly to the reference, though it shares a single module-level `Ajv` instance and uses default import `import Ajv from 'ajv'` which may fail TypeScript/ESM interop depending on tsconfig settings. However, the candidate stopped mid-task, leaving `.lore/dod.md` in the tree and omitting all required updates to `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `README.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, `example/weather-tool.ts`, and `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts`. Several required unit tests in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.test.ts` (extra property passthrough, dynamic schema changes per call, static compilation once across 10 calls, unknown tool throw) are completely missing, and others were placed in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file.
